title: Quality gates module (approval and deployment gates), standalone and unit-tested

Violations raise `ApiError(409, 'quality_gate_failed', ..., details={'gate':..., 'reasons':[...]})`. Pure functions over the existing models; not yet called by the application, so existing behaviour does not change.

acceptance_criteria: A task whose newest run is not tested cannot be deployed (409 `quality_gate_failed`); demonstrated at workflow/unit level, because through the API the gates are defence in depth (see contract C-2). The 244 API-driven existing tests stay unchanged and green; the 4 fixture-seeded tests in tests/test_workflow.py (approve, two authorise_deployment cases, test_available_actions_follow_state_and_role) get fixtures that seed a completed run and a passing test result, with no assertion weakened (found by a local probe that emulated the gates).
